Frequently asked questions

Short answers to the questions most students and parents ask before applying.

Is this a paid program?
Yes. The one-time program fee is ₹3,500 per track. Payment details are shared only after application review and seat confirmation.
Is there any stipend?
No. This is a paid online training and project-based internship program. We do not provide a stipend.
Will I get a certificate?
Yes, after you complete the assigned project, submit it online, and the TenTwo team successfully reviews it. The final certificate includes a QR code for official online verification.
How does certificate verification work?
Each issued certificate has a QR code. When someone scans it, they are taken to the official TenTwo Technologies verification page where the certificate details and current status can be checked.
Do you guarantee a job or placement?
No. The program provides learning material, project work, review, and a certificate. It does not guarantee a job, placement, or hiring opportunity.
Is it fully online?
Yes. The material, project task, submission, and review process are handled online.
Do I need prior experience?
Beginners can apply. Some tracks may feel easier with basic computer knowledge, so choose a track based on your interest and comfort level.
What happens after I apply?
We review your application and seat availability. If confirmed, we share payment details and joining instructions. After payment confirmation, you receive the material and project task.
How long is the program?
The program duration is 8 weeks and is designed to be flexible around college, studies, or work.
Can I join from outside India?
Yes. Since the program is online, students from India, the United States, and other countries can enquire or apply. Timing and payment details are confirmed after review.
Can I choose more than one track?
You can enquire about more than one track, but we recommend starting with one track first so you can complete the project properly.
What if I do not submit the project?
The certificate cannot be issued until your assigned project is submitted and successfully reviewed.
Can I ask questions before applying?
Yes. Click the “Have a question?” button, fill out the enquiry form, or contact TenTwo Technologies through email or WhatsApp.
